content.Differences in Prosthetic Valve Endocard: Lower incidence of vegetations, higher incidence of annular abscess and paravalvular complications compared to native valve endocarditis.
content.TEE Importance: Essential for detecting IE in prosthetic valves with a lower sensitivity.
content.Use of CT: Helpful for non-invasive cardiac assessment and evaluating complications of IE.
content.18F-fluorodeoxyglucose PET/CT: Enhances diagnostic capability for prosthetic valve endocarditis.
content.Staphylococcus aureus Bacteremia: TEE may be necessary in cases without a known extracardiac source.
